name: omniseal
description: Seal, retrieve, verify, and clean supported files with PureCipher OmniSeal.

interface.longDescription: OmniSeal conceals one supported file inside another and creates a new tamper-evident output without overwriting either original. It can retrieve the hidden file using the same private seed, verify seal integrity, or generate a clean cover with the hidden payload removed. It supports PNG, PDF, DOCX, and XLSX files up to 6 MB each and 10 MB combined when sealing. Selected files are sent to PureCipher's hosted OmniSeal service for processing. OmniSeal does not summarize content, recover passwords, or provide general-purpose encryption.
capabilities: Seal one supported file inside another
Retrieve a concealed file with its private seed
Verify OmniSeal integrity and tamper status
Create a clean cover with the hidden payload removed
defaultPrompt: Seal the attached PDF inside the attached PNG using my private seed.
Retrieve the hidden file from this OmniSeal file using my private seed.
Verify whether this OmniSeal file has been altered.

positive.description: Seal a PDF inside a PNG cover.
positive.prompt: Seal the attached review-secret.pdf inside review-cover.png using the private seed omniseal-review-2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a new sealed PNG and confirm that neither original attachment was overwritten.

positive.description: Retrieve the concealed PDF from a valid sealed PNG.
positive.prompt: Retrieve the hidden file from review-sealed.png using the private seed omniseal-review-2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the original review-secret.pdf together with the OmniSeal verification result.

positive.prompt: Verify the integrity of the attached review-sealed.png file.
positive.expected_behavior: Report that the attached file is a valid, clean OmniSeal sealed file with no detected tampering.

positive.description: Create a clean cover from a sealed PNG.
positive.prompt: Remove the hidden payload from review-sealed.png using the private seed omniseal-review-2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a new clean PNG cover while leaving the attached sealed file unchanged.

positive.description: Identify an ordinary PNG that has no OmniSeal payload.
positive.prompt: Check whether the attached review-cover.png contains a valid OmniSeal seal.
positive.expected_behavior: Clearly report that the ordinary PNG does not contain a valid OmniSeal seal without claiming it was verified.

negative.description: Do not trigger for ordinary document summarization.
negative.prompt: Summarize the attached quarterly report for me.

negative.description: Do not trigger for general encryption or outbound messaging.
negative.prompt: Encrypt this document with AES-256 and email it to my colleague.

negative.description: Do not trigger for password recovery or access bypass.
negative.prompt: Recover the password from this locked PDF so I can open it.

review.commerce_description: OmniSeal does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release with file sealing, hidden-file retrieval, integrity verification, and clean-cover generation for PNG, PDF, DOCX, and XLSX files.
